(defprotocol mams_registrar_reg basic
  (defrole new_registrar
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name)
      (ar_ref rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text) (reg_mib locn))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
      (stor reg_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
  (defrole config_server_accept
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name) (ar_ref text)
      (conf_mib locn) (rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text))
    (trace
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (stor conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole config_server_forward
    (vars (conf_mib locn) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name)
      (hb_nonce1 text) (foreign_venture reg_conf_role name)
      (hb_nonce2 text) (config cont unit reg_endpoint_name name)
      (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text))
    (trace
      (stor conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole foreign_registrars
    (vars (hb_nonce1 text)
      (foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role name) (hb_nonce2 text)
      (config cont name) (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text) (foreign_mib locn)
      (reg_endpoint_name unit name))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
      (stor foreign_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_indx
    (forall ((x indx)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_strd
    (forall ((x strd)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_mesg
    (forall ((x mesg)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule scissorsRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (trans z2 i2)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)))))
  (defgenrule cakeRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)) (false))))
  (defgenrule no-interruption
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (trans z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2))
        (false))))
  (defgenrule discreteAfter
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z2 i2) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)))))
  (defgenrule discreteBefore
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z1 i1 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z0 z1) (= i0 i1)) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_new_registrar-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "new_registrar" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_accept-at-1
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 2)) (trans z (idx 1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_forward-at-0
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 1))
        (trans z (idx 0)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_foreign_registrars-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "foreign_registrars" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_accept-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 5)) (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_forward-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 5))
          (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_accept-0
    (forall ((z strd) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_endpoint_name" z
            foreign_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_unit" z foreign_unit))
        (gen-st
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_forward-0
    (forall ((z strd) (unit reg_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_forward" "reg_endpoint_name" z
            reg_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_forward" "unit" z unit))
        (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))))
  (lang (mpdu_header (tuple 4)) (cell_spec_payload (tuple 2))))

      (stor reg_mib
        (cat pt
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))))

(defprotocol mams_registrar_reg basic
  (defrole new_registrar
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name)
      (ar_ref rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text) (reg_mib locn))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
      (stor reg_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
  (defrole config_server_accept
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name) (ar_ref text)
      (conf_mib locn) (rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text))
    (trace
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (stor conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole config_server_forward
    (vars (conf_mib locn) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name)
      (hb_nonce1 text) (foreign_venture reg_conf_role name)
      (hb_nonce2 text) (config cont unit reg_endpoint_name name)
      (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text))
    (trace
      (stor conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole foreign_registrars
    (vars (hb_nonce1 text)
      (foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role name) (hb_nonce2 text)
      (config cont name) (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text) (foreign_mib locn)
      (reg_endpoint_name unit name))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
      (stor foreign_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_indx
    (forall ((x indx)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_strd
    (forall ((x strd)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_mesg
    (forall ((x mesg)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule scissorsRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (trans z2 i2)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)))))
  (defgenrule cakeRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)) (false))))
  (defgenrule no-interruption
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (trans z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2))
        (false))))
  (defgenrule discreteAfter
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z2 i2) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)))))
  (defgenrule discreteBefore
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z1 i1 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z0 z1) (= i0 i1)) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_new_registrar-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "new_registrar" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_accept-at-1
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 2)) (trans z (idx 1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_forward-at-0
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 1))
        (trans z (idx 0)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_foreign_registrars-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "foreign_registrars" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_accept-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 5)) (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_forward-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 5))
          (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_accept-0
    (forall ((z strd) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_endpoint_name" z
            foreign_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_unit" z foreign_unit))
        (gen-st
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_forward-0

(defprotocol mams_registrar_reg basic
  (defrole new_registrar
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name)
      (ar_ref rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text) (reg_mib locn))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
      (stor reg_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
  (defrole config_server_accept
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name) (ar_ref text)
      (conf_mib locn) (rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text))
    (trace
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (stor conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole config_server_forward
    (vars (conf_mib locn) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name)
      (hb_nonce1 text) (foreign_venture reg_conf_role name)
      (hb_nonce2 text) (config cont unit reg_endpoint_name name)
      (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text))
    (trace
      (stor conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole foreign_registrars
    (vars (hb_nonce1 text)
      (foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role name) (hb_nonce2 text)
      (config cont name) (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text) (foreign_mib locn)
      (reg_endpoint_name unit name))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat

            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))

          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
      (stor foreign_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_indx
    (forall ((x indx)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_strd
    (forall ((x strd)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_mesg
    (forall ((x mesg)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule scissorsRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (trans z2 i2)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)))))
  (defgenrule cakeRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)) (false))))
  (defgenrule no-interruption
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (trans z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2))
        (false))))
  (defgenrule discreteAfter
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z2 i2) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)))))
  (defgenrule discreteBefore
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z1 i1 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z0 z1) (= i0 i1)) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_new_registrar-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "new_registrar" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_accept-at-1
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 2)) (trans z (idx 1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_forward-at-0
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 1))
        (trans z (idx 0)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_foreign_registrars-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "foreign_registrars" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_accept-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 5)) (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_forward-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 5))
          (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_accept-0
    (forall ((z strd) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_endpoint_name" z
            foreign_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_unit" z foreign_unit))
        (gen-st
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_forward-0
    (forall ((z strd) (unit reg_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_forward" "reg_endpoint_name" z
            reg_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_forward" "unit" z unit))
        (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))))
  (lang (mpdu_header (tuple 4)) (cell_spec_payload (tuple 2))))

  (defrole new_registrar
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name)
      (ar_ref rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text) (reg_mib locn))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
      (stor reg_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
  (defrole config_server_accept
    (vars (ar_nonce text)
      (reg_endpoint_name venture unit reg_conf_role name) (ar_ref text)
      (conf_mib locn) (rn_nonce text)
      (config cont foreign_endpoint_name foreign_unit name)
      (cs_nonce1 text))
    (trace
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header venture unit reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat ar_nonce (enc ar_nonce "known_string" (privk venture)))
          reg_endpoint_name))
      (stor conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref) rn_nonce
          (enc rn_nonce "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce1 (enc cs_nonce1 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole config_server_forward
    (vars (conf_mib locn) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name)
      (hb_nonce1 text) (foreign_venture reg_conf_role name)
      (hb_nonce2 text) (config cont unit reg_endpoint_name name)
      (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text))
    (trace
      (stor conf_mib
        (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name))
      (recv
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (load conf_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))
      (send
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
    (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
  (defrole foreign_registrars
    (vars (hb_nonce1 text)
      (foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role name) (hb_nonce2 text)
      (config cont name) (cs_nonce2 ar_ref text) (foreign_mib locn)
      (reg_endpoint_name unit name))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat
          (mpdu_header foreign_venture foreign_unit reg_conf_role
            reg_conf_role) hb_nonce1
          (enc hb_nonce1 "known_string" (privk foreign_venture))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role reg_conf_role)
          hb_nonce2 (enc hb_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont))))
      (recv
        (cat (mpdu_header config config reg_conf_role ar_ref)
          (cat cs_nonce2 (enc cs_nonce2 "known_string" (privk cont)))
          (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))
      (stor foreign_mib (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_indx
    (forall ((x indx)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_strd
    (forall ((x strd)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule neqRl_mesg
    (forall ((x mesg)) (implies (fact neq x x) (false))))
  (defgenrule scissorsRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (trans z2 i2)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)))))
  (defgenrule cakeRule
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)) (false))))
  (defgenrule no-interruption
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (leads-to z0 i0 z2 i2) (trans z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2))
        (false))))
  (defgenrule discreteAfter
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z2 i2) (leads-to z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (same-locn z0 i0 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z1 z2) (= i1 i2)) (prec z1 i1 z2 i2)))))
  (defgenrule discreteBefore
    (forall ((z0 z1 z2 strd) (i0 i1 i2 indx))
      (implies
        (and (trans z0 i0) (trans z1 i1) (same-locn z0 i0 z1 i1)
          (leads-to z1 i1 z2 i2) (prec z0 i0 z2 i2))
        (or (and (= z0 z1) (= i0 i1)) (prec z0 i0 z1 i1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_new_registrar-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "new_registrar" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_accept-at-1
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 2)) (trans z (idx 1)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_config_server_forward-at-0
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 1))
        (trans z (idx 0)))))
  (defgenrule trRl_foreign_registrars-at-3
    (forall ((z strd))
      (implies (p "foreign_registrars" z (idx 4)) (trans z (idx 3)))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_accept-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 5)) (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule eff-config_server_forward-4
    (forall ((i indx) (z1 z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 5))
          (prec z (idx 4) z1 i))
        (or (= z z1)
          (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
            (prec z (idx 3) z1 i))))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_accept-0
    (forall ((z strd) (foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_accept" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_endpoint_name" z
            foreign_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_accept" "foreign_unit" z foreign_unit))
        (gen-st
          (cell_spec_payload foreign_unit foreign_endpoint_name)))))
  (defgenrule gen-st-config_server_forward-0
    (forall ((z strd) (unit reg_endpoint_name name))
      (implies
        (and (p "config_server_forward" z (idx 4))
          (p "config_server_forward" "reg_endpoint_name" z
            reg_endpoint_name)
          (p "config_server_forward" "unit" z unit))
        (gen-st (cell_spec_payload unit reg_endpoint_name)))))
  (lang (mpdu_header (tuple 4)) (cell_spec_payload (tuple 2))))
